primaryTextRead.text: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

wikipediaRead.title: Achbor
wikipediaRead.locator: L107–119: the article distinguishes the Edomite Achbor from the Judah officer and states that this Achbor is also called Abdon (2 Chronicles 34:20).
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版のアクボル記事は、ユダの役人アクボルをエドムの同名者と区別し、歴代誌下34:20のアブドンと結び付けています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The dedicated article distinguishes two namesakes and explicitly identifies the Judah officer as Abdon in 2 Chronicles 34:20.
